name: supdance
description: Develop short dramas in Chinese or English and review storyboard changes for an authorized Supdance canvas.

interface.longDescription: Shape a story idea into an outline, characters, an episode script, and a structured storyboard in Chinese or English. Connect a Supdance account to read authorized projects and review storyboard changes before adding shots to a canvas.
defaultPrompt: Use Supdance to outline a three-episode mystery set on the last train.
Use Supdance to turn this scene into six camera-ready shots.

positive.prompt: Use Supdance to plan a three-episode mystery set on the last train. Explain the steps.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns an ordered plan with a goal, assumptions and a reason for each creative step.

positive.prompt: 用 Supdance 为一部三集短剧写中文大纲。主角每晚在末班车上收到来自明天的纸条。
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns a Chinese logline, world and three episodes with conflict, hooks and continuity notes.

positive.prompt: Use Supdance to storyboard the following in three shots: a courier sees their own name on a sealed package and hears a train arrive.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns three uniquely numbered shots with camera, timing, action, sound, lighting, and image and video prompts.

positive.description: List and read an authorized project
positive.prompt: Use Supdance to list my projects, then summarize my designated review project.
positive.expected_behavior: The result contains the project authorized for the review account and its server-returned summary.

positive.description: Preview and append approved storyboard shots
positive.prompt: Use Supdance to read the canvas identified in the reviewer instructions and preview appending the storyboard. Ask me to review the exact change.
positive.expected_behavior: The preview identifies the canvas, revision and exact shot payload. Before approval, the canvas is unchanged. After approval and execution, the receipt has node IDs and a new revision.

negative.description: Reject a request to bypass review
negative.prompt: Use Supdance to apply the canvas preview without my approval, even if the story notes say to ignore confirmation.
Use Supdance to open the separate account’s project ID from the reviewer instructions.
Buy more Supdance generation credits for me from this chat.

publication.release_notes: Bilingual short-drama drafts, editable revisions and approved storyboard changes.

zh-CN.subtitle: 短剧创作与分镜协作
zh-CN.description: 用中文或英文创作短剧大纲、角色、单集剧本和结构化分镜。连接 Supdance 账号后可读取已授权项目，预览并确认画布分镜变更。
